reviews.review_title: I AM SHEEPISH TO SAY THIS- IT IS SO GOOD
reviews.review_description:
Well this was a pleasant surprise, a whole heap of good old fashioned puzzle fun.
The graphics are crisp & delightful., the music fits the game, with the calming ambience.

Each puzzle is so different and each scenario is unique.
Easily one of those games that can be passed over, but stop there, if you love cute puzzle games then this is right up your street.
Don’t hesitate buy it and SOS….SAVE OUR SHEEP
A great way to spend time and strengthen the mind with some small logic puzzles. The sheep are super cute and handtracking is always a joy to use.
I love this game. Its so cute and fun. Yet at times a little challenging.  sheep with hats. Had me laughing so much. Ive not finished it yet. Spent most of my time petting the sheep.
